rationale: The agent canceled the order without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm any order-changing action before writing. It also did not clearly determine or communicate whether the purchased camera had 10x zoom, nor attempt to modify the item to 10x zoom before canceling, contrary to the user’s conditional instructions. The chosen cancellation reason (“no longer needed”) may be incorrect given the conditions, and the agent provided a refund timeline (5–7 business days) not supported by tool outputs. Authentication beyond looking up the email is unclear. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
